remarks: Charming In-Town Rental in the Heart of New Canaan Ideally located at the corner of East Avenue and Raymond Street, this charming rental offers an exceptional walk-to-everything lifestyle, just steps from all that New Canaan has to offer. Features include a welcoming wraparound porch, lovely yard with excellent curb appeal, hardwood floors throughout, second-floor laundry, and a two-car attached garage with driveway access from Raymond Street. A rare in-town opportunity-don't miss this New Canaan charmer!
